sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def sq(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in('R','b','N') and n['pixels']==16 and [p[0] for p in n['boundary']][0]<50:
            d[n['color']]=n['boundary'][0]
    P=[n['boundary'][0] for n in fr.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']==18 and [p[0] for p in n['boundary']][0]<50]
    d['P']=P[0] if P else None
    tips=[max(p[1] for p in n['boundary']) for n in fr.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] in('w','g') and [p[0] for p in n['boundary']][0] in (26,27) and 16<min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])<50]
    d['tip']=max(tips) if tips else None
    return d
print("before:",sq(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT'])
print("after:",sq(current_frame))
print("result:",last_action_result.get('board_changed'),last_action_result.get('level_completed'),last_action_result.get('done'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
